children: Ionis reported that partner Roche’s Phase 3 IMAgINATION study of sefaxersen in IgA nephropathy met its prespecified interim primary endpoint, showing statistically significant and clinically meaningful proteinuria reduction vs placebo at 37 weeks.
De-risks the program; increases probability of approval and future royalties.
Proteinuria reduced vs placebo at 37 wks
Proteinuria reduction is a validated surrogate linked to kidney outcomes.
Supports benefit-risk profile, key for regulatory review and uptake.
Long-term kidney function data will be critical for labeling and adoption.
Roche holds license; royalties to Ionis
If approved, Ionis gains milestone payments and tiered royalties.

This is a mid-to-late stage validation of Ionis’s renal program via a positive interim readout in a pivotal trial. A larger catalyst would be positive eGFR outcomes at week 105, regulatory submissions, and disclosed milestone/royalty economics.
